## d04a3e7210f3

**Reproduced verification defect; audited source unchanged.**  The selected
portable `task_tests` stage exits 2 before pytest.  The task test defines
`ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`, which resolves to the task directory,
and then attempts `ROOT/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`.  That file cannot exist in
the isolated layout.  The preflight names the supported replacement:
`reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)`, `canonical_path`, and `canonical_pairs`.

This finding is bound to generator SHA-256
`b7e6084b88dfdd908cbcf57d2c50ec611d8b2df95c1d874fbbc3a7cfdbdd85e4`
and test SHA-256
`7858a7b96b6e91482ede35436c915a55c2c180fc7749befbe1e76f460e6359ee`.
The generator's semantic implementation was inspected, but because its declared
regression suite cannot run portably, I do not treat the existing assertions as
verified.  I did not modify this target.
